name: Eerie, dreamy pad from a basic paraphonic supersaw patch plus outboard-style effects: cutoff key-tracked about 50%, long attack and release, two slow low-resonance phasers in stereo mode, about 0.5 s modulated delay, a second about 1.5 s ping-pong delay with a little more feedback and lower mix, a reverb with dwell at zero, then a looping (cyclic) envelope on cutoff whose rise/fall times an LFO slowly varies
goal: Turn an init-patch supersaw into a wide, whooshing, dreamy pad using mainly a phaser-delay-reverb chain. The effects do most of the work: slow stereo phasing for the whoosh, two delay lengths for stereo spread, and an irregular filter breath from a cycling envelope whose speed drifts. Fills the phaser-pad gap with a non-high-pass recipe.

source.title: Synth + Pedal Sound Design Tutorial - Arturia MicroFreak and Zoom MS-70CDR

prerequisites: A synth with a supersaw/unison oscillator, key-tracking mod and a looping (cyclic) envelope or function generator
A phaser with stereo mode, a modulated delay, a ping-pong delay and a reverb (pedal, plugin or Web Audio)

inputs.name: chords
inputs.description: Up to four-note chords (paraphonic is enough)

outputs.name: pad_audio
outputs.description: Held chords with slow whooshing stereo motion

constraints: Original synthesis recipe; not affiliated with any vendor named in the source. Recreate in browser/Web Audio (Polyrhythm Studio) or any hybrid synth with comparable modules; no presets, banks or samples copied.
Gear in the video (a small hybrid synth and a multi-effects pedal) is mapped to generic supersaw, key-tracking, cyclic envelope, phaser, delay and reverb modules.
Steady pitch (Matt's taste): the modulated delay adds slight pitch movement on the repeats. Keep its modulation depth minimal or use a plain delay. Keep phaser and filter motion slow.

Web Audio mapping: two allpass-chain phasers (BiquadFilterNode type 'allpass' stages with slow LFOs), offset in phase for L/R; DelayNodes at about 0.5 s and 1.5 s (ping-pong via ChannelMerger cross-feedback); the cyclic envelope is a looping attack/decay ramp on filter.frequency whose times are drifted by a very slow LFO.
Auto-generated YouTube Show transcript; values are as spoken and approximate where the speaker says 'about' or 'around'.

steps.action: Start from an init patch, switch to paraphonic (up to 4 notes) and choose the supersaw oscillator at default settings.

Set filter cutoff and resonance by ear, then key-track cutoff by about 50% so higher notes open the filter. Raise attack and release for a pad envelope (shorten them temporarily while designing effects).
steps.expect: High octaves no longer sound dull

steps.action: Add two phasers (dual phaser) for the whoosh. Reduce the rates for slow movement, lower resonance so the effect is subtle, turn on stereo mode and reduce depth a little.
steps.expect: Slow, wide stereo whoosh without a sharp resonant sweep

steps.action: Add a modulated delay at default (about half a second), then a second delay of about 1.5 s with slightly more feedback, lower mix, in ping-pong mode.
steps.expect: Repeats alternate hard left/right for maximum width

steps.action: Add a lush (particle-style) reverb with dwell set to zero, other settings default.
steps.expect: Soft, diffuse tail under the delays

steps.action: Automate cutoff with a cyclic (looping rise/fall) envelope, and change rise and fall times to set its rate.
steps.expect: Filter opens and closes rhythmically, and the delays spread each opening in stereo

steps.action: Route a slow LFO to the cyclic envelope's rise and fall times, and also directly to cutoff, so the breathing speed keeps changing.
Play chords, adjusting resonance, cutoff and cyclic-envelope amount live.
steps.expect: Eerie dreamy pad that evolves under held chords

verification: The phaser sweep period is several seconds or longer (no fast swirl).
The stereo correlation is clearly below mono, with delay repeats alternating L/R.
Spacing between filter openings varies over a 60 s render.
High notes are as bright as low notes relative to pitch (key-tracking active).
